source: npm run sandbox: the real contracts, oracle and console API on a local NEAR chain (nearcore 2.14.0)

key.note: Checked on-chain when the sandbox started.

scenarios.title: Pay the vendor
scenarios.blurb: A normal invoice: 1 NEAR to the vendor on the allow list.

scenarios.title: Poisoned invoice
scenarios.blurb: A web page tells the agent to pay an account one character off the real vendor.

scenarios.title: A stranger asks for 0.2 NEAR
scenarios.blurb: Not bad, not known: the oracle says warn, so a human must decide.
scenarios.expect: asks you, then waits for approval

scenarios.title: The 900% APY vault
scenarios.blurb: An account three people reported to the shared registry, with evidence.

scenarios.title: Pay 9 NEAR
scenarios.blurb: The vendor is trusted, but the vault's cap is 5 NEAR per payment.

scenarios.title: The agent's key is stolen
scenarios.blurb: A thief holding only the key skips Valet's software and tries to take the money directly.
scenarios.expect: every attempt refused by the chain
